title: festuca dumetorum subsp. nevadensis
intro: Festuca dumetorum subsp. nevadensis, commonly known as Nevada fescue, is a subspecies of grass within the fescue family. It is a type of medicinal plant known for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nevada fescue include wound healing, immune system support, and antiviral activity, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds and flavonoids. The health benefits of this plant are also thought to be due to its high content of sesquiterpenes and other bioactive molecules, which may contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
